name: run-pipeline
facts: A target profile at assets/targets/<slug>.md supplies the domains, the scope statement and the calibration rules
scripts/scan.py runs the check catalog and writes findings, per-check execution state and evidence to JSON
The model adds an exploratory pass and the narrative to that JSON before rendering
scripts/render_report.py turns the JSON into the HTML report
A check that did not run is reported as not-retested, never as resolved
